blocks.text:
After breakfast, a visit is planned to Condor Park near Otavalo. The project cares for, breeds and releases birds of prey, including condors, back into the wild. From the park's viewpoints you can see Imbabura, Cotacachi, Cuicocha crater, Lake San Pablo and the area around Otavalo. The park is home to birds of different sizes, from large condors to small hawks and kestrels. Some birds of prey fly in from the wild, so sightings are not limited to the aviaries.

In addition to the birds cared for at the centre, you may see wild raptors that visit the park area. The surrounding Andean vegetation makes it a suitable place for birdwatching.

Please note: Condor Park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.

In the afternoon, continue to El Ángel Reserve, home to giant frailejones and rare polylepis forests. After dinner, take a short torchlit walk through the old forest while your guide tells a local legend.

Accommodation at Polylepis Lodge 4*. Meals: breakfast and dinner.

The date of the Condor Park visit is arranged around its opening schedule: the park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays.
